doc.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Family and boyhood in Concord and Ione
title: Few memories of the grandparents; grandfather's funeral
summary: Brubeck hardly knew his grandparents, was kept from his grandfather's funeral at about age five, and mentions the Grass relatives in Santa Cruz.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Were your grandparents alive when you were a young boy? Did you have many recollections of them?

Hardly any. I did see Grandpa Louis once. I was not allowed to go to his funeral. I was probably five. I remember my cousin and I just sitting alone in our house. The funeral was next door in the Presbyterian church in Concord.
You were seen as too young to go the funeral, because you were five years old. I can see that.

Yeah. The Grass family was in Santa Cruz. There are some there still, Grasses. I visit there. I can’t remember. There’s even a real-estate office with my cousin’s son, who’s a Brubeck, married to a Chinese woman that runs the real-estate office. I think it’s Wong.
